ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الْبَدْرِ التَّمَامِ وَمِصْبَاحِ الظَّلَامِ الشَّفِيْعِ الْمُشَفَّعِ فِيْنَا يَوْمَ الرَّجْفَةِ وَالْإِزْدِحَامِ ، اَلنَّبِيِّ الَّذِيْ هَيْئَتُهُ نُوْرٌ فَوْقَ نُوْرٍ ، وَرَائِحَتُهُ مِسْكٌ وَنَدٌّ وَ وَرْدٌ وَعَنْبَرٌ وَكَافُوْرٌ ، وَرِيْقُهُ شِفَاءٌ لِكُلِّ عَلِيْلَةٍ وَمَعْلُوْلٍ ، صَلَاةً تُشَوِّقُنَا إِلَيْهِ وَتُهَيِّمُنَا عَلَيْهِ ، صَلِّ اللّٰهُمَّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ كَمَا تُحِبُّ أَنْ يُصَلَّى وَيُسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Badri ‘t-Tamāmi, Wa Miṣbāhi ‘ẓ-Ẓalāmi, Ash-Shafī`i ‘l-Mushaffa`i fīnā Yawma ‘r-Rajfati wa ‘l-Izdiḥāmi, An-Nabiyyi ‘lladhī hay’atuhū Nūrun fawqa Nūrin, Wa rā’iḥatuhū miskun wa naddun wa wardun wa `anbarun wa kāfūrun, Wa rīquhū shifā’un li kulli `alīlatin wa ma`lūlin, Ṣalātan tushawwiqunā ilayhi wa tuhayyimunā `alayhi, Ṣalli ‘lLāhumma wa sallim `alayhi kamā tuḥibbu an yuṣallā wa yusallama `alayh.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, the completely full moon, the lamp amid darkness, the pre-eminent intercessor for us on the Day of Convulsion and Crowding, the Prophet whose form is light upon light, whose scent is musk, incense, rose, ambergris and camphor, and whose saliva is a cure for the ailing, a prayer arousing in us a yearning for him, infatuating us with him! Send prayers upon him, O Allah and salute him as You love that prayers are sent upon him and that he is saluted!
